worked_solution:
Isolating the quadratic term, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}2(x+7)^{2}+4 & \le -6 \\ 2(x+7)^{2} & \le -10 \\ (x+7)^{2} & \le -5.\end{aligned}
$$

However, $(x+7)^{2}\ge 0$ for all values of $x$ because the power $(2)$ is even.

Therefore, there is no solution to the given inequality.
